adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#19
adds.text: Lincoln injects himself with the untested cure Jemma and Fitz are making against Hive's hold and refuses her antitoxin. Jemma later tells him the drug does not work.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman who tests Jemma's untested cure on himself.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist whose untested cure Lincoln injects himself with.
adds.evidence: Failed Experiments (S3#19): Lincoln takes the Hive cure sample against orders as Fitz and Simmons try to stop him, insists Simmons not give him the antitoxin; Simmons later tells him in containment the drug failed.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
adds.text: When the hijacked plane crash-lands at Malick's base, Jemma tends May's wound while the team holds off Hydra in a storage room.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A close friend whose wound Jemma tends at Malick's base.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who tends May's wound at Malick's base.
adds.evidence: The Team (S3#17): after landing at Malick's Schoonebeek base, Simmons, Fitz, Coulson and Mack get the wounded May to a storage room and Simmons takes care of her wound until the Secret Warriors arrive.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
adds.text: After Rosalind Price is killed, Coulson questions Jemma about Ward, and she admits she was once drawn to him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jemma's director, who questions her about Ward.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's closest agents, whom he questions about Ward.
adds.evidence: Closure (S3#9): after Ward kills Price, Coulson interrogates his original team about Ward; Simmons says she was attracted to Ward but he never returned it.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
adds.text: When Hunter and Bobbi are disavowed to keep S.H.I.E.L.D. secret, Fitz and the team say goodbye to them from across a bar with a round of shots.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A good friend who sees Hunter off with a round of shots.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A good friend Fitz sees off with a round of shots.
adds.evidence: Parting Shot (S3#13): Fitz chats with Hunter about a documentary on the Zephyr; after Morse and Hunter are disavowed, the team goes to Teddy's Bar and orders them shots without directly contacting them. Also Among Us Hide... (S3#6): Hunter questions Fitz about helping Simmons save Daniels.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#22
adds.text: Fitz and May sneak aboard Zephyr One after Hive steals it, and after Fitz kills Giyera, he frees Daisy and gets the dazed May out with them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An old friend Fitz sneaks aboard Zephyr One with to stop Hive.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An old friend who sneaks aboard Zephyr One with May and gets her out.
adds.evidence: Ascension (S3#22): Fitz and May infiltrate the stolen Zephyr One; Giyera knocks May out, Fitz kills him, frees Daisy and takes a dizzy May with them.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#10
adds.text: Coulson follows Fitz through the portal to Maveth. Fitz watches Coulson kill Ward, and the two make it back to Earth together.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Fitz's director and friend, who follows him to Maveth.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: One of Coulson's most loyal agents, who escapes Maveth with him.
adds.evidence: Closure/Maveth (S3#9-10): Coulson drops into the castle and through the portal after Ward and Fitz; on Maveth Fitz burns Hive's host while Coulson kills Ward, and they return through the portal together.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#8
adds.text: May asks for Lincoln on her extraction team and, on the flight, apologizes to him for the killings Lash committed. Lincoln thanks her for stopping Lash when she did.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who apologizes to Lincoln for Lash's killings.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: An Inhuman May takes on her team and apologizes to over Lash.
adds.evidence: Many Heads, One Tale (S3#8): May requests Campbell for extraction; on the Quinjet she apologizes to him for Lash's killings and he thanks her. Earlier, Chaos Theory (S3#7): May steps between Lash and Lincoln and calms Lash.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
none.why: Piper only appears in Failed Experiments (S3#19) on the Union City strike team; she helps bring the wounded Mack back for Simmons to treat, but no exchange between Piper and Jemma is shown.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
none.why: Piper's only S3 appearance is the Union City mission under May and Mack (S3#19); Fitz is at the base and they never deal with each other.

none.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
none.why: Coulson leads S.H.I.E.L.D. against Hive's side, but James's S3 clashes are with Daisy and Lincoln (S3#16), Mack (S3#18), May (S3#19) and Lincoln and May aboard Zephyr One (S3#22); no scene or exchange between him and Coulson.
